function.arguments: {"message":"Downgrading a Meridian plan won’t delete any of your data. Features that belong to the higher tier simply become hidden, and the underlying data stays in the workspace. arguments.message: Downgrading a Meridian plan won’t delete any of your data. Features that belong to the higher tier simply become hidden, and the underlying data stays in the workspace. The only exception is if the lower‑tier plan has a shorter data‑retention window – in that case, records older than the new retention period will age out over time, just as they would for a workspace that started on that tier. You can also view exactly which features will be hidden before confirming the downgrade in Settings → Billing → Plan.
